dialogues.speaker: Xi'er
dialogues.text: One of the two major culinary traditions in Liyue, the other being Li.

dialogues.speaker: Xi'er
dialogues.text: Yue-style cooking puts emphasis on lighter, brighter flavors. It's heavily seafood-based, so if that's your thing you have to try it!

dialogues.speaker: Xi'er
dialogues.text: If you do want to try it, the most authentic Yue-style cooking is at the Xinyue Kiosk in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Xi'er
dialogues.text: Only thing is, for both the Xinyue Kiosk and Liuli Pavilion, you have to book about half a year in advance...
